about: Marula app mockup images. Desktop uses the neutral light and dark themes; mobile uses the light and dark themes. States are identical across themes.
frozen_clock: Date fixed to Tuesday 29 September 2026 (11:41 desktop, 13:47 mobile); timers are frozen, so digits do not tick.

images.title: Default ticket workbench, replying to the client
images.what_to_notice: Composer is in Reply to client mode with the assistant's drafted reply. The assistant's Recommended next step card is the one inverted surface on screen (ink in light, cream in dark). The timer bar is ink in every theme. Stepper shows In progress in gold. P1 chip is red. Label reads Visible to John Smith.

images.title: Every timeline entry type, in order
images.what_to_notice: Client entry: bordered surface box with a gold Client tag. Internal note: note-tinted box, no border, Internal tag. System: plain tinted box, System tag. Time entry: gold-tinted box with Billable at right. Assistant suggestion: warm agent tint, spark icon in deep amber, Suggestion tag.

images.title: Internal note mode: the composer changes colour
images.what_to_notice: Switching to Internal note re-tints the whole composer to the same note colour internal entries use in the timeline, so what you type previews where it will land. The label changes to Only your team can see this, the primary button becomes Add note, and the Set to Waiting after send checkbox disappears.

images.title: Internal note added
images.what_to_notice: After Add note: a new Internal entry appears at the bottom of the timeline in the tint the composer had. The composer stays in internal mode and is emptied. Toast: Internal note added.

images.title: Client reply sent, status moves to Waiting
images.what_to_notice: Send reply with Set to Waiting after send ticked: the reply lands as a Client entry, the stepper moves to Waiting (earlier steps gain check marks), and the toast reads Reply sent. Status set to Waiting.

images.title: Status stepper set to Resolved
images.what_to_notice: Clicking Resolved in the header stepper: New, In progress and Waiting show check marks, Resolved is the current step in gold. Toast: Status set to Resolved.

images.title: Activity filter: Client
images.what_to_notice: Active chip is gold-tinted. The timeline shows only client-visible messages.

images.title: Activity filter: Internal
images.what_to_notice: Only internal notes are listed, in the note tint.

images.title: Activity filter: Agent
images.what_to_notice: Only assistant entries are listed, in the warm agent tint.

images.title: Assistant action run
images.what_to_notice: Run profile reset script performed: the button becomes Script ran (disabled) with a check icon, a System entry is appended (Script ran on JOHN-LAPTOP: Always-On VPN profile reset, 0 errors), and a toast confirms.

images.title: Assistant suggestion dismissed
images.what_to_notice: Not this replaces the card with a dashed Suggestion dismissed row and an Undo link.

images.title: Asking the assistant a question
images.what_to_notice: The Likely cause? chip fills the ask box, submitting appends the assistant's answer to the timeline, with the question in bold.

images.title: Timer paused
images.what_to_notice: The pause icon becomes a play triangle and a toast confirms. Timer digits are frozen in this export.

images.title: Quick note field in use
images.what_to_notice: The single-line note field on the timer bar, left of the arrow button and Wrap up, with a line typed in. No large UI is needed to add a note.

images.title: Note lines panel open
images.what_to_notice: The arrow button is pressed (gold border, dark fill) and shows a count badge (4). A panel above the bar lists every note line with a timestamp; each line is editable in place. The footer explains the lines become the time entry notes at wrap-up.

images.title: Note line added
images.what_to_notice: Pressing Enter in the quick note field adds a line: badge becomes 5, toast reads Added to your notes, and the panel shows the new 11:41 line.

images.title: Keyboard focus ring
images.what_to_notice: Two-pixel ring in the primary colour with a two-pixel offset around Send reply, shown on keyboard focus only.

images.title: Wrap up modal, Resolve selected
images.what_to_notice: Time entry 0:25 (plus 0:45 logged earlier) with Remote support, Billable and Rounds to 0:30 tags. Notes are built from the note lines. Checklist has green ticks. The chosen outcome card has a two-pixel green border and green tint (green means chosen or done). Send John the resolution summary is ticked. Primary button reads Resolve and open next.

images.title: Wrap up modal, Waiting on client
images.what_to_notice: Selected outcome moves to Waiting on client and the primary button becomes Set to Waiting and open next.

images.title: Wrap up modal, Schedule follow-up
images.what_to_notice: Selected outcome is Schedule follow-up and the primary button becomes Schedule and open next.

images.title: Wrap up modal, Keep working
images.what_to_notice: Selected outcome is Keep working and the primary button becomes Save and keep working.

images.title: After wrap up: resolved
images.what_to_notice: Modal closed. Stepper shows Resolved, the timeline gains a Time entry (0:25 Remote support, Billable), the timer bar resets to 00:00:00, and the toast reads Resolved #18432. Opening #18440 next.

images.title: Today, offline (default)
images.what_to_notice: Offline banner in the sand tint. Next visit card with a blush Due today pill, a primary Start travel button, and square call and directions buttons. Quick tiles for Scan asset, Add time and Photo. Later list. Pinned running timer (ink bar, gold digits, pause). Tab bar with a raised centre scan button.

images.title: Today, scrolled to the bottom
images.what_to_notice: Reveals the Later list that sits under the pinned timer.

images.title: Today, back online
images.what_to_notice: Tapping the banner toggles it to a green Back online. All changes synced.

images.title: Travel started
images.what_to_notice: Start travel becomes I've arrived, the pinned timer is relabelled Travel to Ridgeline Dental and restarts, and a toast confirms.

images.title: Timer paused
images.what_to_notice: The pause icon on the pinned timer becomes a play triangle.

images.title: On site job screen
images.what_to_notice: Header with an On site pill. Scanned asset row with a green Healthy pill. Checklist with large tap rows: completed steps have green checked boxes and struck-through text. The inverted assistant card shows notes drafted from the checklist. Photo, Voice and Parts buttons. Bottom bar shows the on-site timer and Wrap up.

images.title: Checklist complete
images.what_to_notice: 5 of 5 done: the count and the assistant's drafted notes update.

images.title: Wrap up, Resolved selected
images.what_to_notice: On-site and travel time cards, the drafted notes, an Outcome segmented control (selected segment has the green tint), a dashed signature pad, and a Resolve and sync button with an offline hint.

images.title: Wrap up, Follow-up
images.what_to_notice: Button becomes Schedule follow-up and sync.

images.title: Wrap up, Waiting
images.what_to_notice: Button becomes Set to Waiting and sync.

images.title: Client sign-off drawn
images.what_to_notice: A signature drawn in the pad; the stroke colour follows the theme's text colour.

images.title: Wrap up while online
images.what_to_notice: The hint below the button changes to Syncs straight away.

images.title: After resolving, offline
images.what_to_notice: Returns to Today with a toast (Resolved #2905. Will sync when you reconnect.) and the banner now reads 4 changes will sync when you reconnect.
